description:
Personalized developer news aggregator. Stay on top of software development news, AI coding tools, and web dev - curated daily from trusted sources.

Feeds — your personalized For You feed, trending posts, filtering by tag or source
Posts — full post details, AI summaries and comment threads
Search — posts, tags and sources
Bookmarks — read and manage your saved content, including folders
Feed settings — follow or block tags and sources, and build custom feeds
Notifications — your activity feed and unread counts
Profile and reading streak — read and update your experience, tech stack and streak
Marketplace — browse plugins, and submit or update your own

defaultPrompt: Summarize what's happening in developer news today
Add interesting posts to my bookmarks based on my reading preferences
